summary: SECA requests procedural changes to the Draft Order and a revision to CIPA language. SECA argues that requiring all consortium members to complete FCC Form 479 in the Electronic Payment Center (EPC) imposes undue administrative burdens and could delay or prevent consortium leads from certifying Form 471 on time. They request that the draft order allow consortium leads to upload completed Form 479s on behalf of members, provide a 120‑day grace period for compliance, and align the Form 479 deadline with the Form 471 certification deadline.
